title: Trustpilot reviews
description: Three row types share one dataset: review (one Trustpilot review, charged), company (the profile's TrustScore, histogram and contact block, free) and status (one per company, free).

dataset.title: Trustpilot reviews
dataset.description: One row per review, plus a company context row and a status row per company. Charged rows are billed as delivered; company and status rows are always free.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: One JSON record with the counts this run delivered and charged, its error, capped and duplicate tallies, and its HTTP and token stats.
